disclaimer: Combination findings are INDICATORS FOR FURTHER REVIEW, NOT proof of malware, surveillance or data exfiltration. A legitimate feature may fully justify any combination.

combinations.title: Location combined with contacts
combinations.rationale: Precise location plus an address book enables building a social-location graph: who the user knows and where both the user and those people are. Neither permission is needed for the other's function, so co-presence deserves review.
legitimate_justifiers: Social/messaging apps showing friends' locations with consent
combinations.additional_evidence: In-app consent flow, Data Safety declaration, whether contacts are uploaded
combinations.remediation: Confirm location is only shared with explicit consent; consider a contact picker instead of full contacts read.

combinations.title: Microphone combined with background execution
combinations.rationale: Audio capture that can start or persist without the app being in the foreground is the classic covert-surveillance pattern. The pairing warrants review even when each permission is individually plausible.
legitimate_justifiers: Voice recorders that continue with screen off
Voice calling apps with a visible ongoing notification
Navigation with spoken guidance (mic not usually needed)
combinations.additional_evidence: Foreground service with persistent notification, user-initiated recording trigger, disclosure UI
combinations.remediation: Record only while the app is visible or via an explicit user action; show an ongoing recording indicator.

combinations.title: Broad file access combined with network access
combinations.rationale: Unrestricted read access to user files plus a transmission channel creates a direct path for mass data exfiltration. Review what is actually uploaded and whether users are informed.
combinations.additional_evidence: Network destination list, Data Safety form, upload confirmation prompts
combinations.remediation: Use user-selected files via SAF/Photo Picker, and disclose any upload before it happens.

combinations.title: SMS access combined with contacts
combinations.rationale: Message content plus contact identity plus call history is the full communications dataset — one of the most sensitive aggregates available to an app and heavily restricted by Play policy.
combinations.additional_evidence: Default-handler declaration, whether data leaves the device
combinations.remediation: Drop SMS/call-log permissions unless the app is genuinely the default handler.

combinations.title: Multiple critical permissions without an established purpose
combinations.rationale: Two or more of the most sensitive capabilities together, in an app whose purpose does not obviously require them, is a strong over-privilege indicator.
combinations.additional_evidence: Declared category, feature descriptions, data flow review
combinations.remediation: Strip the least-justified permission first; re-request only at the point of use.

combinations.title: Package installation capability with network access
combinations.rationale: Downloading and then installing code outside the Play Store is a high-risk combination associated with droppers and update-hijack attacks.
legitimate_justifiers: Self-updating apps distributed outside Play with user consent
combinations.additional_evidence: Download sources, signature verification, user confirmation flow
combinations.remediation: Use the Play In-App Updates API or link to the store listing instead of installing APKs.

combinations.title: Screen overlay combined with credential/message access
combinations.rationale: Drawing over other apps while reading messages enables tap-jacking and capture of text typed elsewhere — a documented phishing technique.
legitimate_justifiers: Caller-ID apps showing a small overlay
combinations.additional_evidence: Overlay scope and content, whether sensitive fields are overlaid
combinations.remediation: Remove SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW; use full-screen or notification-based UIs.

combinations.title: Installed-app inventory combined with sensitive data access
combinations.rationale: A full installed-app list reveals behavioural traits (health, dating, finance, religion); combined with personal data it substantially increases profiling capability.
combinations.additional_evidence: Whether app lists are transmitted, Data Safety declaration

combinations.title: Biometric or device credentials paired with broad outbound access
combinations.rationale: Authentication features plus broad system visibility warrant review of where credential-adjacent data can flow.
combinations.remediation: Scope storage and package queries to the minimum needed.
